items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6648

SPONSOR: SANDERS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the banking law, in relation to including participation
in a banking development district as a factor when assessing a banking
institution's record of performance

 
PURPOSE:

To accurately assess the performances. of a bank when in a development
district.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Amends the banking law to establish Subparagraph 10a.

Section 2. Effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Banking Development District (BDD) Program is working to lower the
number of unbanked/underbanked New Yorkers. To achieve this goal, there
must be banks in these areas. This bill is being proposed to include the
participation in a Banking Development District as part of institutions
record of performance.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the thirtieth day after it shall have
become a law.

approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 86 Chapter 658
 
        MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 6648, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to amend the banking law, in relation to including partic-
        ipation in a banking  development  district  as  a  factor  when
        assessing a banking institution's record of performance"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This  bill  proposes to include participation in a Banking Development
District as a factor in evaluating financial  institutions'  performance
records.
 
  I  recognize the need to expand access to banking services, especially
in underbanked areas that are disproportionately home to communities  of
color.  However,  by  imposing  uniform  mandatory criteria, it fails to
account for the diverse needs of different  communities  and  consumers.
Changes  are  necessary  to allow for some flexibility with the criteria
discussed in this bill to better serve these communities.
 
  I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these chang-
es.  On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Includes participation in a banking development district as a factor when assessing a banking institution's record of performance in relation to the Community Reinvestment Act of 1977.
